all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: every identifier is derived from content — snapshot, partition, boundary and assessment ids alike — so the module holds no clock, no randomness and no new_id at all

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: license, integrity and novelty vocabularies are read positionally from their canonical schemas with every position pinned by an assertion, the novelty field NAMES are selected by declaration order because one of them is itself an enum value elsewhere, and every emitted canonical record passes validate_artifact

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: snapshot identity is the sorted content hashes, drift is refused on re-validation, a document in two partitions is leakage by construction, holdout handles must be drawn from the pinned snapshot, and prior art outside the declared boundary or after the as-of bound is refused

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: the holdout seal is delegated to the firewall's own builder with its refusals surfaced rather than re-implemented, and the reachable novelty ladder is capped below both canonical ladders' tops so a corpus-bounded search can never claim novelty review eligibility

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: parallel agent; reviewer: primary session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
